description.en: Code-generated Chinese video skill plugin, proposal-first and zero-template. You keep only a film.json in your project and run the skill scripts in place (no copying). Each brief is sampled into several distinct design candidates (no built-in style packs); the user confirms one and it is frozen into a design DSL. visual.subtitle controls caption style and visual.layout_cycle rotates layouts per chapter, while a cross-film design ledger keeps delivered videos from repeating. Pipeline: script, measured TTS timeline, cue-driven programmatic SFX and score, deterministic PIL/browser frame rendering, ffmpeg encoding, sample-level mixing, and multi-layer QA gates (preflight / full-film VMAF+SSIM / ASR read-back). v1.0.2 adds zero-copy rendering, custom caption style, per-chapter layout rotation and cross-film dedup; 67 self-check assertions and 12 repo checks are green.
description.zh: 中文视频生成技能插件：提案优先、零模板。工程目录里只需要一个 film.json，技能脚本留在技能目录里直接跑，不用拷贝任何脚本或模板。每个 brief 现场采样出多个互不相同的设计方案（没有内置风格表），用户确认后才冻结成设计 DSL。design 里的 visual.subtitle 控制字幕样式、visual.layout_cycle 按章节轮换版式；片间去重台账记录交付过的设计，让不同片不重复。管线：写剧本 → 实测 TTS 时长排轴 → 提示点驱动配乐与音效 → PIL/浏览器逐帧渲染 → ffmpeg 编码 → 采样级混音 → 多层质检（渲前预检 / 全片 VMAF+SSIM / ASR 回读）。v1.0.2 带来零拷贝出片、可定制字幕样式、片内版式轮换与片间去重；自检 67 条、仓库体检 12 项全绿。
